newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares jump as volume picks up.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares jump as volume picks up.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed 1.73 percent on Wednesday as investors snapped up stock on weakness.

"Obviously investors regarded prices as low enough to start buying, if similar demand continues until the end of the week, then maybe we can say our market has finally picked up," Jernej Obed, a trader at A bank, said.
* The SBI index rose 22.18 points to 1,303.68.
* Overall 11 shares rose, five fell and two were flat, while eight were untraded.
* Turnover jumped to 93.9 million tolars from 45.6 million. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
